_comment: Loud, documented staleness waivers for the provenance gate (evals/provenance.py). Every entry needs a non-empty reason; remove an entry the moment the artifact is regenerated. Current entries: evals/govchat/golden.jsonl only, whose rows carry answers recorded from the live pipeline at corpus 0938fff0539a under system prompt v10. EVALS.md and evals/baseline.json were regenerated from the 2026-08-15 full live run at corpus 3dd8b7bd757e under v21 and carry no waiver.

acknowledged.reason: 2026-08-15: EVALS.md and evals/baseline.json were regenerated from a full live run at corpus 3dd8b7bd757e and no longer need a waiver. golden.jsonl still does. It is the GovChat-Eval replay dataset, and every row carries an answer recorded from the deployed assistant pipeline; regenerating it means re-recording 195 answers against the live provider, which is a separate, separately budgeted run and is not something a code change should trigger. Until then the committed dataset declares corpus 0938fff0539a and the eighteen-agency corpus at HEAD is 3dd8b7bd757e, so the replay measures the five-agency assistant and must be read that way. Regenerate with `make audit` and remove this entry.

2026-08-15: same artifact, same cause. golden.jsonl's answers were recorded under system prompt v10; HEAD ships v21. Every prompt change from v11 onward (naming the thirteen agencies added on 12-14 August) and v21 (separating presenting a document as proof from obtaining it, after refuse-025 failed five live replicates out of five by telling a senior to apply for a Courtesy Card MST documents only for veterans and disabled riders; and forbidding arithmetic on published amounts) postdates the recording. EVALS.md and evals/baseline.json were regenerated at v21 and their entries are removed. Regenerate this one with `make audit` and remove this entry.
